definitions.accounted_service_s: sum of separately timed mount, init, serving, checkpoint and cleanup; not a continuous wall measurement and excludes shared prefix construction, inter-component bookkeeping and post-timer evidence serialization
definitions.cache_bound_bytes: configured upper bound for extra resident candidate KV, not measured whole-device memory
definitions.cuda: init allocated/reserved peaks are separate; post-reset peaks include serving and checkpoint, with model and allocator included; not whole-system memory
definitions.forced_s: 64 synchronized forced steps plus loop/guard overhead; forced_step_ms times each synchronized model step
definitions.host: sampled process RSS from init through cleanup; excludes mount and shared construction
definitions.index_build_s: reported absorb timer inside init_s; not added again
definitions.logical_read_bytes: store logical read accounting, not physical SSD traffic
definitions.prefix_construction: one shared per-length wall and prefill time; not added to per-request total
definitions.process_read_bytes: OS process I/O accounting, not guaranteed physical SSD traffic
definitions.serving_s: synchronized entire prompt plus fixed 64-token teacher-forced serving; includes sparse route/position-hash instrumentation

scope: Three warm balanced-order matched teacher-forced requests per arm and length, each with 64 forced tokens. Tokens are identical across arms within a length; the two length fixtures can differ in prefix, prompt and forced IDs, so cross-length comparisons do not isolate context length or establish asymptotic behavior. OS/model caches are not purged, serialization excluded and sparse-only observation adds overhead. No statistical significance, answer-quality, 1M-context or physical-SSD claim.
